subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback remain fail-closed whenever current microphone health is unknown, with a bridge recovery requiring a fresh explicit unmuted observation?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility-sensitive readiness policy, not only a mechanical bug fix: existing users may now see talkback withheld until browser health is observed.

options.title: Keep fail-closed and require fresh health
options.body: Retain the stricter unknown-microphone policy, fix stale-health recovery, and require proof that audio starts only after a current unmuted observation.

options.title: Preserve cached-health recovery
options.body: Permit bridge recovery from previously verified health and accept the possibility that later mute or browser-loss state is not detected before audio starts.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed and require fresh health
recommendation.body: Retain the stricter unknown-microphone policy, fix stale-health recovery, and require proof that audio starts only after a current unmuted observation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch and the merged meeting-bot extraction history place this readiness-policy follow-up in the same feature area.
